subject: ML Leaders Dinner @NeurIPS'25
text:
Hi [NAME],

Given your focus on multimodal research, thought you might be attending
NeurIPS next week. Our founder [SENDER] is hosting a small dinner for
AI/ML research leaders attending the San [SENDER] conference on Tuesday
(12/2). I'd love to extend an invite.

We've reserved a private room at Herb & Wood from 6:30pm, with guests
joining from Pinterest, Inflection AI, TwelveLabs and more. We're capping
the attendance at 20 to ensure engaging discussions.

For context: Encord helps 200+ AI teams improve data quality at scale. We
unify curation, model-assisted annotations and human review in one
platform, and across image, video and text contexts.

Would you be interested in joining us on the 2nd?

subject: AI Leaders Dinner @NeurIPS - San [SENDER]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Will you be at NeurIPS in San [SENDER] this year?

Our co-founders, [SENDER] and [SENDER] are hosting a private dinner
to kick off the conference on *2 Dec @ Herb & Wood*, and we'd love for you
to join us! It'll be an intimate event for ~30 founders and tech leaders in
AI to connect and chat.

Quick context on Encord... we're a SF-based data development platform
($50M, Series B) built for computer vision and multimodal AI, supporting
200+ AI teams like Onfido (Entrust), Veriff, and VIDA working on IDV use
cases.

Let me know if you're interested - I'll share more details and reserve a
spot for you!

subject: Catch up? Dinner @NeurIPS
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the recent announcement of IVM! Wondering if you're attending
NeurIPS this year? If so, [SENDER] is hosting a dinner for Heads of AI
attending the conference on Tuesday (12/2). We'd love to catch up!

We've reserved a private room at Herb & Wood from 6:30pm, with guests
joining from Woven (Toyota), Qualcomm, Field AI and more. We're capping the
attendance at 20 to ensure engaging discussions.

Also we've just onboarded Zipline's 3D team - they now uses Encord for both
2D and 3D annotation. Would be great to share updates from our end on LiDAR
annotation, as well get your thoughts on new development on IVM going into
the new year.

Would you be interested in joining us on the 2nd?

subject: [NAME] - coffee catch up
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well!

Saw you'll be at RSNA this year, so I thought it would be a good
opportunity to get introduced.

I'm a part of Encord - we help med AI teams like Flatiron Health, Viz.ai,
and Highmark Health streamline multi-reader annotation and QC through
built-in consensus workflows, structured review stages, and RBAC. Our
hierarchical ontology builder also ensures consistent, high-quality
labelling across studies.

It would be great to grab a quick coffee and exchange perspectives. I'll be
at RSNA Sunday-Tuesday. Would Monday afternoon work for you?

subject: Use SAM3 now
text:
Hi [NAME],

We just released a new workflow that lets you use text prompts to automate
object tracking and segmentation in video using SAM3.

Given your focus on surveillance/monitoring use cases, I think this could
save your team a significant amount of time and manual effort.

Would you have time next week for a quick chat to see how this would work
for [COMPANY]? I'm pretty flexible next Tuesday to Thursday.

subject: SAM3 + Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

You can now use SAM3 auto-segmentation with text prompts directly in Encord
- perfect for speeding up object tracking and video annotation projects.

Wanted to personally reach out as I thought this might be relevant given
your focus at [COMPANY]. Call out some features that might interest you:

   - Text prompt to auto-segment multiple objects in images and video
   - Track object in videos forward and backwards through time (play video
   natively)
   - Build SAM3 workflow and accelerate annotation

Open to seeing a tailored demo on how that would look in your current
workflow? I'm free Mon to Thu next week.

Have a good Thanksgiving break with your family!

subject: MultiModal Speech Eval Platform
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been working with a few frontier labs like Synthesia, Captions, and
Flawless on speaker detection, language identification, and
transcript-quality evaluation for their LLM and speech pipelines.

I know Otter focuses heavily on handling these challenges especially when
accents, diarization, and noisy environments make things harder for your
proprietary models.

At Encord we offer a full multimodal platform to curate, annotate, and
evaluate audio + text side-by-side, which tends to help teams tighten
feedback loops and improve model performance faster.

Would you be open to a quick chat? Happy to see whether (or not) this
aligns with your current work

subject: ML Ops at [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the partnership with Docusign! I'm reaching out because we work
with teams like Entrust (Onfido), Veriff, and VIDA on their IDV and facial
recognition workflows. Specifically, they use Encord to solve bottlenecks
in hard-negative mining and agentic QA that their internal tools couldn't
handle at scale.

Given the high-stakes models you run at [COMPANY], I thought this might be
relevant. Quick context... we're a data development platform built for
computer vision and multimodal data (audio, text, image, video, etc),
supporting 200+ AI teams managing curation, labeling, QA, and model eval
one one platform.

Would be great to compare notes and get your thoughts on what we've built.
Open to a quick 30 min chat next week? I'm pretty flexible Monday to
Thursday mornings PT.

text:

Encord.

You can now use text prompts (e.g., "delivery person") to auto-segment

Have a great Thanksgiving!

subject: ML platform for your Multimodal Data
text:
Hey [NAME],

One pattern we're seeing with our customers like 1X Robotics and Boston
Dynamics is that even with frontier VLA models, you still need a strong
robot-specific data engine.

Encord helps humanoid teams turn teleop demos and multi-camera/depth
sequences into clean, versioned datasets for training and regression
testing.

It's how they mine edge cases, keep manipulation/locomotion evaluation
consistent, and tighten the perception→action loop as hardware evolves.

I'd invite you to check out [LINK] and let me know what you think.

subject: Model Evals for Palmyra
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been working with frontier labs like Thinking Machines, Yutori,
Synthesia, Captions, on various model evals.

I saw the Palmyra's which tells me you may be considering how to best do
evals as we approach year-end.

We offer a multimodal data platform so you can align the models you train
on the right behaviours with a mix of pre-labeling with LLMs + humans in
the loop.

Would you be open to a quick conversation?

-[SENDER]

subject: [NAME] - chat / darwin
text:

a number of teams migrate to Encord as V7 has shifted focus away from
Darwin, and several mentioned challenges with labelling service quality
- is this something you've also run into?

annotation. We also provide consistent & reliable annotation services.

Would you be open to a quick 15 mins call early next week for us to chat?

subject: Virtual coffee? - annotation efficiency
text:
Hi [NAME],

I met Max Curie from IAS's data science team at ICCV - sounds like human
annotation and taxonomy work are central for brand safety and contextual
relevance. Given your close involvement with both teams at IAS, I wanted to
reach out for a chat.

From our projects with other content verification teams (DoubleVerify &
Zefr) - frame-by-frame, manual annotation is a typical bottleneck. Encord
helps orchestrate AI-automated classification and human review in one
place, so your team can focus on QC'ing edge cases and updating annotation
policies with minimal handoffs between data science & annotation teams.

How are you thinking about annotation efficiency at IAS? I'm flexible Wed -
Fri this week.
